name: More Glowing Scorpid Blood
label: Quest
description: More Glowing Scorpid Blood: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: That scorpid blood is working out great, friend! It's amazing how a little sparkle and shine can create a prized bauble out of an otherwise piece of junk. The patrons love the stuff, and love is what it's all about, don't you think...
You've been a big help to me, friend, and although I don't have a great need for more glowing scorpid blood, if you bring me more then I'll still trade you some tickets.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks again, friend. Here are your tickets!
